collection_statement: The Soap Creek Valley oral histories were recorded between 1989 and 2009 and print the words of narrators born between 1890 and 1930, together with historical documents reproduced as appendices. Some interviews contain terms for African Americans, American Indians, and people of Asian, Mexican and European descent, and language about women and disability, that readers will find offensive today. Some contain personal information about named individuals — health, deaths, criminal allegations, addresses — and describe the locations of American Indian burial and artifact sites. The narrators reviewed and approved these transcripts. Nothing has been altered. Page-level notes identify specific passages so readers can approach the material knowingly.
policy: Content notes, not edits. Nothing in the transcripts has been altered. Only high and medium severity notes are displayed; notes categorised not-an-issue are excluded.

counts.note_on_counts: items > source_notes_shown because a note printed against a page range ('73-74') is expanded to one item per page.
